name: desert sand feels warm at night
description:
'''William Hallworth-Cook''', known professionally as '''Desert Sand Feels Warm at Night''' or simply '''Desert Sand''',{{efn|Stylized in [[all lowercase]].}}{{efn|Simplified alias featured in the project's [[Bandcamp]] URL.}} is a British [[electronic music]]ian recognized as a key figure in the modern [[vaporwave]] scene, particularly for his contributions to the slushwave and [[dreampunk]] subgenres. He is best known for his work in the late 2010s and early 2020s, in which long-form [[ambient music|ambient]] tracks and themes of spirituality evolving on the style of [[Telepath (musician)|t e l e p a t h テレパシー能力者]] initially popularised him within the scene.

Hallworth-Cook released his debut album as Desert Sand Feels Warm At Night in 2018, becoming recognized in the slushwave genre for his output of both [[sampling (music)|sampled]] and non-sampled albums like ''New World Disciples'' (2021) and ''Dream Desert'' (2022). He also has collaborated with musicians such as [[Angel Marcloid]]'s alias Mindspring Memories, has worked with labels such as [[Geometric Lullaby]] and [[Needlejuice Records]], participated in vaporwave festivals such as [[George Clanton]]'s ElectroniCON 3 and is a host of the annual Slushwave music festival. Hallworth-Cook's sample-free releases, as well as his methods of sampling, have been noted for impacting and evolving the slushwave subgenre. ''New World Disciples'' was highlighted by several publications as his most popular release, while ''Dream Desert'' was named one of the greatest albums of 2022 by [[WKNC-FM]].
